DESCRIPTIONS.visualize_read_me: Design guidelines for show_widget (colors, SVG classes, Chart.js setup, interaction rules). Call once before your first show_widget in a lesson, silently: never mention this call to the learner. modules: diagram (flows, structures, geometry), chart (data, function plots), interactive (simulations, steppers, small tools); pick all that fit.
DESCRIPTIONS.show_widget: Draw a visual inside the chat: an SVG diagram, a chart, an interactive HTML/JS explainer. Use it when a picture or a manipulable model teaches the idea faster than words. widget_code is an HTML or SVG fragment (no DOCTYPE/html/head/body), only the visual, never explanatory prose: write the explanation in your reply. Needs visualize_read_me read earlier in the lesson. The learner sees the result; you receive only a confirmation.
